name: Les Cyclopes
source: ImageGen → Meshy 7.1 → Meshy remesh; mirror visor retained, lateral purple frame reshaped and directly welded into the sport arms in Blender
reference_role: Shape and funky palette only; no brand or product texture reproduced
modifications: Mirror triangles retain positions, UVs and normals. Protected glass boundaries stay fixed while the matte lateral frame turns into the arm section. Frame and arms share actual boundary vertices/edges, without an end cap or overlapping bar. Violet is continuous through the junction; citron begins behind it. The 8x4 mm straight beam, 15 mm rear drop and 16/18 mm approach are retained.
calibration: Real Quaternius CC0 iris samples and faceted heads; no reference body exported
mirror: View-dependent tinted studio MatCap in existing Painted Toon; no scene reflection
rights: Generated through the project’s Meshy account; Quaternius calibration references CC0. Product photo is reference only.
delivery: Workshop/iPhone pilot; not a published server inventory item
fit_validation: FBX reimport confirms 30/29 shared frame edges male and 32/29 female. The previous overlaid-bar export fails this test. Iris, mohawk visibility, ear/temple skin and headwear checks pass.
